character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A spectral scholarly figure in tattered dark brown librarian robes, translucent grey-blue skin, 
wearing small round glasses on a gaunt elderly face, surrounded by floating misfiled books 
and scrolls drifting in the air around it, long thin fingers holding an open ledger, an ancient 
archive-dwelling ghost aesthetic. Single image containing a 1x4 sprite sheet grid (one row, 
four equal-sized cells, evenly spaced, no overlapping, consistent character scale and 
proportions across all four cells, same baseline/ground line in each cell, neutral idle standing 
pose in every cell). Cell 1: FRONT view (facing camera/viewer). Cell 2: LEFT view (facing left, 
full side profile). Cell 3: BACK view (facing away from camera). Cell 4: RIGHT view (facing 
right, full side profile). No background scenery, no UI elements, no text, no labels. Art style: 
16-bit pixel art, retro SNES-style RPG sprite, clean black outline, flat cel-shaded coloring, 
transparent background, soft ambient lighting, crisp pixel edges (no anti-aliasing blur), vibrant 
saturated color palette, 8K resolution upscale of pixel art
